thought.text: The `2` argument was passed to docker compose by mistake. Let me restart the build correctly:

reasoning_content: The build failed with "no such service: 2". The "2" in `nohup ... 2 >` got interpreted weirdly — the command was `nohup docker compose build --parallel 2 > /workspace/build.log 2>&1 &`, and because of `2 > /workspace/build.log`, the "2" was passed as an argument to docker compose build! The correct form should be `> /workspace/build.log 2>&1` without the `2`. Let me redo it.

action.command: cd /workspace && nohup docker compose build --parallel > /workspace/build.log 2>&1 & echo "started, pid $!"

tool_call.name: terminal
